sn22.88:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn22.88:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā assaji kassapakārāme viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn22.88:1.3: atha kho āyasmā assaji upaṭṭhāke āmantesi
sn22.88:1.4: “etha tumhe āvuso yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamatha, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatha
sn22.88:1.8: “sādhu kira bhante, bhagavā yena assaji bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
sn22.88:1.9: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato assajissa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn22.88:1.10: assaji bhante, bhikkhu ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno. so bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati. evaṃ ca vadeti.
sn22.88:1.11: sādhu kira bhante, bhagavā yena assaji bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā’ti.
sn22.88:2.1: atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā assaji tenupasaṅkami.
sn22.88:2.2: addasā kho āyasmā assaji bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
sn22.88:2.4: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ assajiṃ etadavoca:
sn22.88:2.5: alaṃ assaji, mā tvaṃ mañcena samañcosi.
sn22.88:2.7: nisīdi bhagavā paññatte āsane. nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ assajiṃ etadavoca:
sn22.88:2.8: “kacci te assaji khamanīyaṃ? kacci yāpanīyaṃ? kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti? paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamo’ti?
sn22.88:3.1: na me bhante, khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamoti.
sn22.88:3.2: kacci te assaji na kiñci kukkuccaṃ na koci vippaṭisāroti?
sn22.88:3.3: taggha me bhante, anappakaṃ kukkuccaṃ anappako vippaṭisāroti.
sn22.88:3.4: kacci pana taṃ assaji, attā sīlato na upavadatīti?
sn22.88:3.5: na kho maṃ bhante, attā sīlato upavadatīti.
sn22.88:3.6: no ce kira taṃ assaji attā sīlato upavadati, atha kiñca te kukkuccaṃ, ko ca vippaṭisāroti?
sn22.88:3.7: pubbe khvāhaṃ bhante, gelaññe passambhetvā kāyasaṅkhāre viharāmi, sohaṃ taṃ samādhiṃ nappaṭilabhāmi.
sn22.88:3.8: tassa mayhaṃ bhante, taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhato evaṃ hoti
sn22.88:3.10: ye te assaji, samaṇabrāhmaṇā samādhisārakā samādhi sāmaññā tesaṃ taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhataṃ evaṃ hoti
sn22.88:4.4: viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti? aniccaṃ bhante …pe….
sn22.88:4.8: so sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati sā aniccāti pajānāti. anajjhositāti pajānāti. anabhinanditāti pajānāti.
sn22.88:4.9: dukkhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati, sā aniccāti pajānāti. anajjhositāti pajānāti. anabhinanditāti pajānāti.
sn22.88:4.10: adukkhamasukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati, sā aniccāti pajānāti anajjhositāti pajānāti. anabhinanditāti pajānāti.
sn22.88:4.11: so sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati visaññutto naṃ vediyati. dukkhañce vedanaṃ vediyati visaññutto naṃ vediyati, adukkhama sukhañce vedanaṃ vediyati visaññutto naṃ vediyati.
sn22.88:4.14: so kāyapariyantikañce vedanaṃ vediyamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti. jīvitapariyantikañce vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti.
sn22.88:4.15: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantīti pajānāti.
sn22.88:5.1: seyyathāpi assaji, telañca paṭicca vaṭṭiñca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya.
sn22.88:5.2: tasseva telassa ca vaṭṭiyā ca pariyādānā anāhāro nibbāyeyya.
sn22.88:5.3: evameva kho assaji bhikkhu kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti. jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmī’ti pajānāti.
sn22.88:5.4: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantīti pajānātīti.
